comment: The Prism as a product, after afflom/prism-devrel's Architecture (ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 stakeholders, concerns, viewpoints), Users (ISO 9241-11 goals and usability measures) and Features (journeys). It grows one journey at a time: a journey is 'works' only once its walk passes for a synthetic person, and from then on every PR and every live deploy must keep it working. tools/product/gate.py checks this record against the surface, the coherence registry and the walks; test/product/screen.test.mjs keeps the system view off the screen; test/product/journeys.test.mjs walks every journey. Nothing here is ever shown on the page.

concerns: my day is there without setting anything up
nothing I owe or am owed slips
each thing that needs me takes one gesture
what I jot down lands in the right place
my questions are answered with where the answer came from
I am left alone when I ask for quiet
nothing about me leaves my device without my say
every change keeps every working journey working
the journey furthest from its target is built next
every part of the back end serves a journey

viewpoints.means: what the person sees and does: the front end, in the person's own words
what runs on its own: the back end, never shown to the person and never asking them to manage it

machinery.comment: Words of the system view that no surface entry names: each is shown on the screen only if back-end machinery leaks through.

journeys.name: My day appears
journeys.goal: The first time I open my Prism, my real day is there without my setting anything up
journeys.done: A fresh profile on a device that holds the person's mail and calendar shows today's meetings on Today, with no press, within a minute

measure.says: seconds from first open to today's meetings on Today, with no gesture

journeys.name: Morning brief
journeys.goal: Each morning I see what today holds and who is waiting on me
journeys.done: Today lists today's meetings, what is due, and the messages waiting on the person, ahead of everything else

measure.says: share of today's meetings, deadlines and waiting messages that Today shows first

journeys.name: Clear what needs me
journeys.goal: Nothing slips: what needs me is in one list that I can clear
journeys.done: A list named Needs me holds the message that asks the person something, and one gesture on it takes it off the list

measure.says: share of things promised or asked for that were done on time

journeys.name: Reply
journeys.goal: Answering a message takes one gesture because the reply is already written
journeys.done: Opening a message that asks something shows the message as it reads, a reply already drafted, and Send; one press sends it

measure.says: gestures for each message that needs a reply

journeys.name: Jot it down
journeys.goal: What I jot down lands at the right time and place, once
journeys.done: Jotting 'Call the dentist Friday at 3' from Today puts it on the Calendar on Friday at 3 PM, and it is shown in one place only

measure.says: share of jotted things that land at the right time and place, once

journeys.name: Find a time
journeys.goal: When someone asks to meet, free times are offered and one press answers and books it
journeys.done: A message asking to meet shows free times; picking one drafts the reply and puts the event on the Calendar

measure.says: gestures from a meeting request to a booked time

journeys.name: Ask
journeys.goal: My questions are answered in a sentence, with where the answer came from
journeys.done: Asking 'When is my flight?' answers with the flight and a link to the item it came from

measure.says: share of questions answered in a sentence with their source

journeys.name: Before I meet someone
journeys.goal: Before I meet someone I see what is open between us
journeys.done: Opening a person in People shows what is open between the person and them: their latest message and the next meeting

measure.says: share of meetings preceded by what is open with that person

journeys.name: Who I am
journeys.goal: My Prism knows which part is me, so it can tell me from everyone else
journeys.done: Today says who the person is, read from their own mail; one press confirms it, and it is kept on the device

measure.says: gestures to establish who the person is

journeys.name: Connect a service
journeys.goal: Each service I use is connected from one place in Settings, one guided step at a time
journeys.done: Settings shows a Connections section with a row for each service the person uses, its state and the one next step; following the steps leaves it live

measure.says: steps the person takes to connect one service

journeys.name: Quiet when I ask
journeys.goal: When I ask for quiet, nothing interrupts me
journeys.done: Quiet is one switch in Settings; once on it stays on, and the Prism sounds nothing until the person turns it off

measure.says: interruptions during Quiet that the person did not allow

always.name: I never see machinery
always.says: words or controls of the system view on the screen

always.name: It stays mine
always.says: things about the person that leave the device without their say
